none: PAS CAM-DA4652: Roman Coin : An Incomplete Copper-alloy Nummus of Valens, AD364-378
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete copper-alloy nummus of Valens, AD364-378. Mint is uncertain, AD364-375, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. Reverse shows Emperor advancing right, holding standard and dragging captive. Obverse shows bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]ALEN[...]. Die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 1.27g, diameter is 15.99mm
